name: ia-details: no disc split
why: A show's files named "1-01. …" / "2-01. …" are two discs: one sub-table each, as release-tracks has one per medium.

name: ia-details: no derivative columns
why: vzell's answer Q3: a file's copies (VBR MP3, …) are columns of its row.

name: ia-details: no pictures and facts
why: The item's pictures and facts go above the tables after the render, as release-tracks' Cover art section and Sidebar cards.

name: ia-details: a picture does not open the viewer
why: A click on a picture opens the artwork viewer on every picture of the item (_dpArtViewerClick on the strip).

name: ia-details: All files shows the tracks
why: The second button lists every file, one row each.

name: ia-details: a video item gets its file list
why: A video item's table is its video files with a Play here tile.

name: ia-details: the item's own content has no previews
why: An item page is plain HTML; its content (main#maincontent) previews before any button.

name: ia-details: the toolbar named as a search
why: An item page's section is named after the item.
grep: the toolbar is named after the item
